visual_qa_checks: all text remains inside the 58px safe area except full-bleed imagery
no body text is below 18px and no label text below 9px
images are not stretched and follow the specified focal crop
every image has meaningful alt text
unverified claims are labelled source hypothesis or creative illustration
no timestamp, price, performance or quiz state is presented as verified unless sourced
footer and internal/not-client-approved state are visible on every page
speaker notes identify source and evidence status
no overflow, overlap or clipped heading is reported by presentation validation
editable text remains native rather than flattened into a page image
All five types occur in the required order; repeated territory/application pairs follow commissioned scope.
Brand palette, typography and imagery come only from the exact client-manifest version.
A creative illustration is labelled once clearly; no fabricated quote, product claim, UI behaviour or result.
Rendered pages require visual inspection; structural validation does not establish layout quality.
No new variant is used without a versioned layout definition and rendered review.
